primary_gates.long_horizon: Every main condition has at least 2/3 runs at generation >=15, and at least one registered run reaches generation >=20.
primary_gates.material: Every registered run is finite, external_fitness_events=0, and max_abs_material_residual < 1e-7.
primary_gates.stable_loss_without_hgt: Stable HGT-OFF finishes with grammar_absent_frequency >=0.75 and mean_active_modules <=0.5 in at least 2/3 runs.
primary_gates.stable_hgt_rescue: For at least 2/3 paired stable seeds, HGT-ON lowers absent frequency by >=0.30 versus HGT-OFF, records hgt_reentries>=1, and ends with persistent_hgt_reentry_grammar_cells>=1.
primary_gates.long_delay_expression: Across HGT-ON holdouts, long-delay mean_active_modules exceeds stable by >=0.50 and is higher in at least 2/3 paired seeds.
primary_gates.mutation_control: Mutation-OFF is reported as a mechanistic control and is not used to alter the primary gates.
primary_gates.all_results: All listed seeds and conditions are reported regardless of sign.

claim_limits: The long-horizon engine is a coarse-grained material chemostat and not a replacement for the 0.6.6 particle microphysics.
Mutation re-entry and HGT re-entry are counted separately; HGT rescue requires the HGT-specific counters and persistent HGT descendants.
No result establishes open-ended evolution, life, consciousness, or universal neural advantage.
